description: Land Acquisition - Matuwagala, Kiriella D/S Division, Ratnapura District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of a specific land parcel (Lot "A" - Matuwagala Estate) for public purpose. It contains detailed land description including extent (0.0506 Hectare), boundaries, survey details, and location information. While it mentions Minister Harin Fernando by name, the primary focus is on land acquisition procedures and property details, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel classification.
